submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly drawn W sprite. Paint ONE new cast/W/07 frame. Images 2/3/4 are the authoritative portrait, W idle camera and approved painted game-art style. Preserve Image 1's exact head and face pixel size, proportions, full-canvas placement, pure screen-LEFT side view. Never mirror an E image. Do not zoom or fit bounding boxes.
Anatomy: exactly two shoulders, two arms, two sleeve openings and two hands. Camera-near anatomical LEFT hand grips bronze bell with red tassel. Far anatomical RIGHT hand grips fan of EXACTLY FIVE separate red rectangular talisman cards, their five rectangular top edges clearly countable. Continuous sleeve-wrist-hand connection, no third sleeve. Do not swap props.
THIS FRAME POSE: Mid-release, a small but clear next pose from Image1. Far RIGHT hand reaches about2% canvas further toward screen-left and3% upward, keeping exactly the same FIVE-card fan and unchanged card/head scale. Fan panels five only: two on each side of center, no extra edge panels. Its elbow straightens more, right shoulder reaches forward, no extra empty sleeve. Near LEFT hand bends inward and lifts the bell handle about3% canvas, bell mouth now angled more downward, red tassel lagging toward screen-right. Torso leans a little more forward LEFT and chin points forward; knees remain deeply bent in stable front/rear stance, feet same planted positions. Ponytail ribbon and robe hem continue trailing screen-right. Mouth a little more open, still purely LEFT facing.
Preserve the chestnut high ponytail, jewel crown, flame-pattern red/gold short robe, black trousers, yin-yang waist ornament, red/black/gold shoes, youthful face and rounded clean richly painted Taoist chibi style. The body can naturally rise/fall a little while bending knees; the head and all props keep identical pixel dimensions. Ground virtual y920 and root x512 at1024. No automatic per-frame resizing. Keep both hands and feet separated and readable.
Single native square frame at least1024x1024 with genuine transparent RGBA, no scenery, shadows, light effects, detached flames, particles, text or labels. No contact sheet, only this single pose.
